tolerance.default: node values, starts, lengths and slide values within 1e-9; ids, order, counts, labels and texts exact

notes: start: the selection, primary, active node, note order and arming after the setup; each step after lists only what changed in it: changed = {id, note} for a new note (C.note shape) or {id, set} with the fields that changed (set.c / set.gen: only the lanes that changed, null = flat at the default / none); removed = ids that went

each case runs the prototype page (sl-ui.js in a stub DOM) from a fresh start: input.clip, then input.setup (mode, subLane, snap = the grid in beats with 0 = Free, free = Freehand on, multi, sel and primary, inst = a patch on the init sound preset, bpm); BW 64, RH 14, nothing scrolled

steps: down / move / up (x, y in roll pixels, mods), menu (a right-click at x, y; pick = the item clicked, null = none; menu = what it showed: #header, - separator, ~disabled, [a|*b] a row with b on); t = the page clock in ms (two presses within 320 ms and 22 px on the same kind of thing are a double-click)
after.notes = false: the notes were not recorded in that step (Freehand paints in between); the next step lists its changes against the last recorded notes

after: order = every note id in clip order; changed notes in the C.note shape; hist = undo steps since the setup and label the newest; sel in time order; active = [id, lane, k] of the inspector node; readout and toast texts (null = none)

cases.name: double-click empty space makes a 1-beat note on the grid (one undo step "Add note")
a new note in a scale: scale lock snaps the pitch (C major, row of C#)
grid 1/8 and grid 1/2: the note is max (1 beat, grid) long, its start floored to the grid
grid Free: the note starts where clicked
grid 1 beat: a note 1 beat long
the double-click stretches the new note while held (one step "Add note")
the new note held and dragged up past 0.4 row bends its end (one step)
two clicks too slow (400 ms) or too far apart (30 px) make no note
a double-click past the clip end makes nothing
a new note near the clip end is cut at the end
a click on empty space clears the selection (no undo step)
a click on a note selects it; a click that moves nothing makes no undo step
Ctrl+click adds a note to the selection and removes it again
Multi on: a click adds to the selection
drag a note: grid snap of the move and pitch by rows (one step "Move notes")
drag a selected chord: every selected note moves (one step)
a move with scale lock lands on scale notes
a drag that goes out and comes back changes nothing: no undo step
a move stops at the clip start and end
pitch moves stop at the roll edges
drag the end dot sideways: the length on the grid (one step "Change length")
the end dot moves the end pitch only after 0.4 row (5.6 px), then in semitones
the end dot bends at most 12 semitones and the length never under the grid
drag the start dot: the start moves, the end stays (one step "Move note start")
an end dot pressed and let go without moving: no undo step
Shift+click a second note: the earlier one slides into it ("Slide into"), again removes it
Shift+click on the band above a note slides too; a Shift drag from the band does not
the slide handles of a legato pair: length and curve (one step each)
